subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Death Wakes A Snake
email_body:
Hi Vikki,

Your Taylor Texas Mysteries caught my eye, especially the setup of nurse Christie Taylor returning to her family ranch in the Hill Country for a slower pace and finding a corpse instead. Death Wakes A Snake extends a series with real small-town Texas charm.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Death Wakes A Snake is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Death Wakes A Snake best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
